recipe.source: ShanghaiTech normal training videos, all 330 videos
recipe.primary_metric: equal-target macro per-video-minmax pooled frame AUROC (N)
recipe.changed_loss: 0.5 MSE(A_normal, ones) replaced by 0.5 MSE(A_normal, source-motion soft target)
recipe.inference: unchanged full-frame negative PSNR, no weighting or fusion
recipe.changed_component: Normal term target of N attention affirmation loss only

performance_policy.routine_report: N, delta N, per-target N; no bootstrap intervals
performance_policy.bootstrap: internal archive only, not a performance gate

baseline_deviations: Independent implementation uses raw-dot memory addressing; paper specifies cosine
Independent implementation uses ResNet18 scalar normalcy classifier; paper specifies PatchGAN for N and D

normal_attention_target.input: first four source normal frames only; fifth target not used
normal_attention_target.motion: Mean absolute adjacent RGB difference over three temporal transitions and channels; 32x32 nonoverlapping average pooling gives 8x8
normal_attention_target.centering: u=relu(s-lower_spatial_median(s)); stable sort values, index31 of64
normal_attention_target.motion_target: T=0.5+0.5*u/max(u); if max(u)<=1e-6 use all ones
normal_attention_target.gradient: target detached, no gradient through motion proxy
normal_attention_target.control_matching: Per-sample target histogram, min/max/mean and Lp norms; not loss/gradient magnitude or equal overlap.
normal_attention_target.parameter_selection: fixed source-only heuristic, no target selection or sweeps
